title: Ninja Partners LLC: Customer Service Representative II (Seasonal)
text: Headquarters: Texas, United States URL: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=41a778b2-3a5e-42c7-9770-87f62458fb3e&ccId=9200871460505_2 Work Setup: Remote/WAH Equipment: (BYOD) Bring-Your-Own-Device Salary: $16/hr The Customer Service Representative II is responsible for handling incoming customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat and resolving customer issues in a timely and professional manner. What does a day in the life of a Customer Service Representative look like? Responds promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via a maximum of two communication channels such as, phone, email, or chat Provides in-depth information about products and services to customers Resolves complex customer issues in a timely and efficient manner Follow up with customers to ensure that their issues have been resolved to their satisfaction Properly and accurately document customer interactions in the organization’s CRM Handle cases that require escalation to higher-level support or management and ensure they are resolved efficiently Effectively manage high-pressure situations, maintaining professionalism and composure while resolving issues Adhere to company policies and procedures Meet or exceed performance targets for related KPIs Continuously improve knowledge of products, services, and processes by participating in training programs and continuous learning modules Collaborate with other departments as needed to resolve customer issues Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers and colleagues at all times Perform other duties as assigned Provide customer support via phone and chat for a US tax-filing platform. Handle tax filing and product-related inquiries, including refund status, filing requirements, tax documents, IRS statuses, W-2s, dependents, and other high-level tax questions. Assist customers with account, payment, and basic product/app issues, including troubleshooting when documents or features are not working. Explain tax and financial information and help customers understand what information/documents they need to complete their return. Handle customer interactions with patience, professionalism, and a nonjudgmental approach, particularly given the stressful nature of tax-related inquiries. Escalate more complex tax questions to a potential higher-tier tax professional, subject to final model/scoping confirmation. What are the required qualifications of a Customer Service Representative? 2+ years of customer-facing support experience● Experience supporting customers over the phone Ability to explain complicated information in simple, conversational language Ability to recognize when to escalate rather than provide an answer; client identified knowing when not to answer as a core competency Experience handling stressful customer situations with patience and professionalism Prior experience in tax preparation, tax software, fintech, banking, insurance, or another regulated financial product Availability during tax season, including some evenings and weekends during peak periods Warm, calm, patient, conversational, nonjudgmental, thoughtful, and confident without bluffing. If you are interested, you can access your instant interview here: https://alpharun.com/i/LPgNWmtnbZuOoRc9nAdMd Disclaimer: The duties and responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is in general terms and are not definitive. The post holder is expected to accept any reasonable alterations that may from time to time be necessary. SupportNinja is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics under federal, state, or local law. title: Resolv.Global: Seasonal Customer Care Representative
text: Headquarters: Ciudad de México, Mexico URL: https://resolv.global ﻿We are seeking customer-focused and dependable Seasonal Customer Care Representatives to join our growing remote team. In this role, you will support customers across phone, email, webchat, and social channels , helping resolve inquiries related to orders, billing, product information, returns, and general account support. We’re looking for strong communicators who can deliver professional, empathetic service while thriving in a fast-paced remote environment. If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and creating positive customer experiences, we’d love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities Provide excellent customer service through phone, email, chat, and social channels. Assist customers with order inquiries, returns, billing questions, and product information. Accurately enter customer and order information into internal systems. Resolve customer concerns professionally and escalate issues when necessary. Maintain records of customer interactions and actions taken. Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and support sales initiatives. Collaborate with team members and supervisors to ensure smooth operations. ﻿Qualifications Strong English verbal and written communication skills Customer service or call center experience preferred Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment Basic computer proficiency and ability to navigate multiple systems Typing speed of 30+ WPM preferred Flexible and team-oriented attitude ﻿Work Environment Fully remote position Must be comfortable working with your camera on during the entire shift Must be comfortable working weekends and flexible schedules as needed Independent contractor agreement Weekly payments in USD $5.50 USD per hour ﻿Equipment We will provide a laptop; however, to be considered for this role, you must have an additional monitor, a USB headset, and a stable, wired (Ethernet) internet connection. ﻿ ﻿Hiring Process To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process. Our process includes: Resume Review Pre-Screen Questionnaire One-Way Video Interview Pre-Screen interview Live Interviews Background Check Please Note ﻿ This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills. All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position. A background check might be required for candidates who are shortlisted as part of the final hiring process. Employment will be subject to successful completion of the applicable background check. Requirements Requirements Advanced English proficiency Minimum of 1-2 years of Customer Experience experience Strong communication and organizational skills Professional attitude and ability to multitask Strong computer literacy To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/resolv-global-seasonal-customer-care-representative

title: SimpleTiger: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
text: Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role. We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly. As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch. Key responsibilities Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on) Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along Qualifications and skills You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working. Required skills WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one. HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates. Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site. APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack. Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues. Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t. Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack. Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision. Nice-to-have skills Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure. PHP development experience. Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients. Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices. Experience with Git and version control. What success looks like Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences. Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot. Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality. Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact. Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows. Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early. Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-web-developer-wordpress-hubspot-u-s-based-remote-contractor
